system.description:
You've learned to see the cracks in this world, and you slip through them. You are sharp, fast, and you strike without warning, plunging your blade into soft, unguarded flesh. Law? You care nothing for it. You play a game of risk and ruin, savouring every thrill as you dance between the shadows, forever walking that narrow edge between triumph and oblivion.

Class feature: Hit 'em where it hurts
Strike when they least expect it. When you hit a foe with an attack made with Boon, or a foe that is Blinded, Restrained, Slowed or has one of your allies adjacent to it, you deal an additional d6 damage.

Class power: Backstab 🟒1 ◈◈
